note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: Autumn dressing moves from city streets to cozy cabins: a viral New York lookbook (200K likes) cycles through a burgundy coat, camel trench, long gray coat and cream turtleneck with wide-leg pants, while a pastel knit set pairs oversized sweaters, plaid skirts, knee-high socks and teddy-bear-motif scarves and bags for cabin weekends, and a Paris carousel styles a brown cropped leather trench with black pants and pointed heels.
trends.title: Autumn city-to-cabin layering — burgundy coats, camel trenches, cozy knits

trends.details: The mantel is the fall focal point: one time-lapse builds a lush, asymmetrical garland of deep red foliage, berries and whole pomegranates over a stone fireplace, a popular home tour styles dried burgundy eucalyptus in a gold vase with velvet pumpkin pillows and brass accents, and a 370K-like seasonal transformation layers pumpkin candles, dried botanicals and plush pumpkin pillows around a lit fireplace.
trends.title: Fall mantels and dried-botanical styling — pomegranates, eucalyptus, velvet pumpkins

trends.details: Fall makeup turns toasty and warm: a 58K-like beginner tutorial builds a sun-kissed look with bronzer placed high on the cheekbones, temples and forehead, a toasty reddish-terracotta blush and brown eyeshadow, while a 320K-like soft fall routine pairs brown liner and a soft wing with cream blush, nude-brown glossy lips and shimmery lids, and a first-fall-look tutorial keeps it soft with cream blush, cafe-toned eyeshadow and a chocolate balm.
trends.title: Toasty fall makeup — warm bronzer, terracotta blush, soft brown eyes
